Since $z$ is nonzero purely imaginary:
\[
\cos\theta=\frac45,\quad \sin\theta\ne \frac35.
\]
Thus from $\sin\theta=\pm\frac35$, we get
\[
\sin\theta=-\frac35.
\]
So
\[
\tan\theta=\frac{-3/5}{4/5}=-\frac34.
\]
Then
\[
\tan\left(\theta-\frac{\pi}{4}\right)
=\frac{\tan\theta-1}{1+\tan\theta}
=\frac{-\frac34-1}{1-\frac34}
=\frac{-\frac74}{\frac14}
=-7.
\]

\boxed{-7}
